channel.description: Recent content in Research on Prashant K. Jha

item.title: Mechanics and design of field-responsive materials
item.description: How electric and magnetic fields interact with microstructure, interfaces and geometry, and how those interactions determine actuation, adhesion and degradation in soft composites.

item.title: Fracture and failure in heterogeneous materials
item.description: How matrix cracking, interface debonding, particle fracture and contact interactions compete to control strength, toughness, localization and residual load capacity.

item.title: Reliable scientific AI for mechanics, discovery and design
item.description: How residuals, error estimates and targeted high-fidelity solves can determine when a reduced or learned model is accurate enough for inference, optimization or design.
